name: SELECT scenetrip
db_statement: WITH display AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (pi.place_id) pi.place_id, pi.name, pi.address, pi.description, pi.lang AS shown_lang FROM place_i18n pi WHERE pi.place_id = ? AND pi.lang IN (?) ORDER BY pi.place_id, (pi.lang = ?) DESC, (pi.lang = ?) DESC ), origin AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(? AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint(CAST(? AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST(? AS DOUBLE PRECISION)), ?)::geography END AS point ) SELECT p.id, d.name, p.type, d.address, d.description, p.naver_place_url, d.shown_lang, -- 목록에서 빠진 촬영지(1.20.0, MZ2AZ-451). 상세는 열린다 — 앱이 「담기」 를 막는 데 쓴다. p.hidden_at IS NOT NULL AS delisted, ST_Y(p.geom::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(p.geom::geometry) AS longitude, CASE WHEN o.point IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE round(ST_Distance(p.geom, o.point))::INT END AS distance_meters FROM place p JOIN display d ON d.place_id = p.id CROSS JOIN origin o WHERE p.id = ?

name: SELECT scenetrip.place_image
db_statement: SELECT url FROM place_image WHERE place_id = ? ORDER BY sort_order, id

name: SELECT scenetrip
db_statement: WITH display AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ci.content_id) ci.content_id, ci.title FROM content_i18n ci WHERE ci.lang IN (?) ORDER BY ci.content_id, (ci.lang = ?) DESC, (ci.lang = ?) DESC ), scene AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (pci.place_content_id) pci.place_content_id, pci.relation_description FROM place_content_i18n pci WHERE pci.lang IN (?) ORDER BY pci.place_content_id, (pci.lang = ?) DESC, (pci.lang = ?) DESC ) SELECT c.id AS content_id, d.title, c.poster_url, c.producer_url, s.relation_description, -- 장면 스틸 — 한 장이 한 줄(V33, MZ2AZ-429). 보여 줄 순서대로 묶는다. 없으면 빈 배열. ARRAY(SELECT pci.url FROM place_content_image pci WHERE pci.place_content_id = pc.id ORDER BY pci.sort_order, pci.id) AS scene_image_urls FROM place_content pc JOIN content c ON c.id = pc.content_id JOIN display d ON d.content_id = c.id LEFT JOIN scene s ON s.place_content_id = pc.id WHERE pc.place_id = ? AND c.hidden_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.popularity_score DESC, c.id DESC

name: SELECT scenetrip
db_statement: SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.url, NULL::TEXT AS storage_key, NULL::BIGINT AS review_id, o.credit, o.thumbnail_url, o.license, ? AS part, NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS created_at, o.sort_order, o.id FROM (SELECT url, NULL::TEXT AS credit, NULL::TEXT AS thumbnail_url, NULL::TEXT AS license, sort_order, id FROM place_image WHERE place_id = ?) o UNION ALL SELECT NULL, ri.storage_key, r.id, NULL, NULL, NULL, ?, r.created_at, ri.sort_order, r.id FROM review r JOIN review_image ri ON ri.review_id = r.id WHERE r.place_id = ? AND r.removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT ? FROM user_block ub WHERE ub.blocker_id = CAST(? AS UUID) AND ub.blocked_id = r.user_id) ) u ORDER BY part, -- 우리 사진은 정렬 순서대로, 리뷰 사진은 최신 리뷰부터 그 안에서 올린 순서로 CASE WHEN part = ? THEN sort_order END, CASE WHEN part = ? THEN id END, created_at DESC, id DESC, sort_order LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

AS part, NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS created_at, o.sort_order, o.id FROM (SELECT url, NULL::TEXT AS credit, NULL::TEXT AS thumbnail_url, NULL::TEXT AS license, sort_order, id FROM place_image WHERE place_id = ?) o UNION ALL SELECT NULL, ri.storage_key, r.id, NULL, NULL, NULL, ?, r.created_at, ri.sort_order, r.id FROM review r JOIN review_image ri ON ri.review_id = r.id WHERE r.place_id = ? AND r.removed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT ? FROM user_block ub WHERE ub.blocker_id = CAST(? AS UUID) AND ub.blocked_id = r.user_id) ) u

name: SELECT scenetrip.review
db_statement: SELECT round(avg(rating)::NUMERIC, ?)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS average, count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = ?) AS r1, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = ?) AS r2, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = ?) AS r3, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = ?) AS r4, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = ?) AS r5 FROM review WHERE place_id = ? AND removed_at IS NULL
